parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
For new public instances or Enterprise instances, the instance has an ID. You must specify this ID, otherwise the call fails.
For legacy public instances, the instance has no ID. You do not need to specify an ID.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
